scripts.dev:site: cross-env PORT=3000 BROWSER=none npm -w apps/site run start
scripts.dev:booking: npx wait-on tcp:3000 && cross-env PORT=3001 BROWSER=none REACT_APP_API_BASE=http://localhost:5000 npm -w apps/booking/frontend run start
scripts.dev:api: npx wait-on tcp:3000 && cross-env PORT=5000 npm -w apps/booking/backend run dev
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c magenta,green,blue,gray "npm --workspaces=false run dev:site" "npm --workspaces=false run dev:booking" "npm --workspaces=false run dev:api" "npm --workspaces=false run open:site"
